item.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: <p>In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Teams

item.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: <p>Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: <p>Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: Send availability in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: <p>We are bringing back send availability on both iOS and Android. iOS users will now also be able to access more of this feature via keyboard and voiceover.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Duplicate events in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: <p>We are adding the ability to duplicate an event. Simply go to the event details and select "duplicate event"</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook

item.description: <p>The header and navigation refresh feature delivers a modern, intuitive, and efficient model app experience across the app shell, form pages, and view pages. item.title: Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: <p>A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Excel

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
item.description: <p>Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
item.description: <p>We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detail (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Integrate the Sales Development agent with Salesforce
item.description: <p><strong>Sales Development Agent now integrates with Salesforce, enabling organizations to use SDA with their existing Salesforce CRM.</strong> SDA can access leads, manage prospect records, log sales activities, and keep engagement actions—including qualification, disqualification, and ownership (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)
